polityNote: Islamic Republic of Iran: the de jure provinces (ostan) from the 1986 census (24 provinces) to 2019. Atoms: geoBoundaries IRN ADM2 (432 shahrestan, OpenStreetMap/Wambacher, ODbL, 2017); the whole period is drawn from this one set (the earlier Natural Earth dossier began in 1993 and could not separate Tehran/Zanjan/Qazvin, Tabas or Razavi/South Khorasan). Province of each 2017 county = the gb ADM1 point test, corrected where gb ADM1 is wrong or ambiguous (Bandar-e-Gaz → Golestan, Chardavol → Ilam, Hajiabad → Hormozgan, Miandoab → West Azerbaijan); the polygon gb names «Paveh» inside Tehran province is a Tehran county (by position, Pardis) and «Shahariar» inside Alborz is Fardis. Valid-since claims rest on Statoids’ change history and the fa.Wikipedia articles of the provinces (Markazi, Tehran, Zanjan, Qazvin, Semnan, Yazd, Fars, Kerman, Isfahan, Hormozgan, Bushehr, Kohgiluyeh, Chaharmahal, Kurdistan, Hamadan, Lorestan, Ilam, Khuzestan, Sistan, West Azerbaijan, South Khorasan) read for inter-provincial transfers after 1355 SH — only Qom (1365), Abarkuh (1366), Qazvin (1373/1376), Takestan (1376), Tabas (1380/1391), Qaenat/Sarayan/Ferdows (1383–1385) were found; village/dehestan transfers not recorded there would invalidate a span. Territory occupied by Iraq during the 1980–88 war and the 1971 Abu Musa arrangement with Sharjah do not change the de jure provinces (the build’s test 3 checks the era map). Independent check (①): today’s provinces as unions of the atoms ÷ the official areas in en.Wikipedia «Provinces of Iran» (oldid 1345255752): 22 of the 25 provinces with a stated area within ±1.5% (Tehran and Alborz counted together) (e.g. Isfahan 1.002, Fars 1.001, Razavi Khorasan 0.991, Golestan 0.998, Qazvin 1.000, Qom 0.997; Tehran ∪ Alborz 1.002 against the pre-2010 Tehran figure), Kerman 0.979, South Khorasan 0.984, Yazd 0.966. The 1980s areas in Statoids’ table differ from the unions by −17%…+16% but equally from today’s official areas of unchanged provinces (e.g. Kordestan 24,998 vs 29,137 km²), so they are survey estimates and cannot test the historical claims.
